caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic jug shown from three different perspectives: a main central view, an upper left view, and a lower right view. The jug is rendered in shades of beige and light brown, with detailing in blue. The main central image presents the jug in profile with a prominent curved handle on the right and painted floral designs in blue on the surface. The upper left inset shows a similar jug, featuring a blue painted design of a bird standing next to a flower. The lower right inset displays the back of the jug, highlighting the handle and additional blue floral motifs. The background is yellowish-beige, and each jug view is framed with fine lines. The artist’s signature, “Yolande DeLasser,” is located at the bottom left of the drawing.
title: Water Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
